null_construction: rfft along time; one random phase vector shared by all 19 channels; irfft. Preserves the donor covariance matrix exactly, hence p_art and the frozen SNR scaling are unchanged.

decision_rule_frozen_before_results.null_matches_observed: 95% subject-level intervals of observed and null medians overlap -> the cross-term carries no pair-specific information; report the interaction-secondary finding as a quantitative magnitude statement.
decision_rule_frozen_before_results.positive_control_must_increase: interaction_required must increase monotonically in beta; otherwise the measurement instrument is broken and S1 is void.
